name: Innovex International, Inc.
description: Innovex International Inc designs, manufactures, sells, and rents mission-critical engineered products to the oil and natural gas industry. Its products are Subsea, Surface Wellheads, Well Construction, Well Completion, Production Solutions, Fishing & Intervention. Its products support upstream onshore and offshore activities. The group's geographic regions are North America, Latin America, Middle East & Asia Pacific, and Europe & Africa.
